experiments.scope: Organizer-executed reconstruction of one committed SHA-256/32 witness from the embedded tuple record, retained #227 compact-table slices, and tail record. The old retained table uses 26-bit buckets and 609,229,824 entries. The program repeats the same deterministic derivation for every organizer trial, while the organizer independently checks the full-collision event.
experiments.hypothesis: The committed historic compact-table slices deterministically derive two distinct 128-byte messages with equal complete-message sha256-r32-prefix-v1 digests matching the committed expected digest. This experiment tests one-record witness lineage only and makes no inference about the current 27-bit TAB2 cardinalities or completeness, attack cost, search success probability, or resource use.
